title: Real weapon swings
changes: Melee attacks are now full-body swings: the weapon winds up, the shoulders turn into the blow, the front foot steps in and the swing follows through, leaving a trail along the arc it cut.
Each hero has four different blows: a forehand diagonal, a backhand, an overhead chop and a flat sweep or lunge, depending on the weapon.
Monsters with weapons swing for real too, picking one of three different blows each time, instead of a single lunge.
